function_v0.doc:
Disabled. A share is a claim on bTokens sitting in this contract's Blend position, and the
two only stay in lockstep because every burn goes through [`Self::redeem`], which withdraws
the backing in the same call. A raw burn destroys the claim and leaves the bTokens in the
position with nobody able to reach them \xe2\x80\x94 no recovery path, since the shares that addressed
them no longer exist. SEP-41 wants the entrypoint to exist, so it exists and refuses.
function_v0.name: burn

Hand the admin role to `new_admin` (current admin only).

`upgrade` is admin-gated and this contract has no other way to move that role, so without
this the deploying key kept un-timelocked code-replacement authority over it forever \xe2\x80\x94 the
governance handover could rotate the engine, vAMM and broker but not this.

SEP-41 `burn` / `burn_from` on the share token. Shares are a claim on bTokens held in this
contract's Blend position, so destroying them outside [`redeem`] would leave that backing
with no owner and no way to reach it \xe2\x80\x94 permanently. Exiting is `redeem`, which burns and
withdraws together.
